Figure 4: Overview of the multi-agent framework: (1) The Director Agent converts the input intent, chart data, and duration into a structured animation plan. (2) The Plan Critic Agent reviews the plan to verify that it aligns with the intent. (3) The Coder Agent translates the approved plan into executable HTML and D3.js animation code. (4) The Video Critic Agent evaluates the rendered video to detect issues in timing, narration–animation alignment, or visualization quality, and sends corrections to coder agent for regeneration if needed.
